---
title: "08-nanoplot"
output: html_document
date: "2025-10-26"
---



```{bash}
mkdir -p ../analyses/09-nanoplot/

for fq in ../data/pacbio-reads/fastq/*.fastq{,.gz}; do
    [ -e "$fq" ] || continue  # skip if no match
    sample=$(basename "$fq" .fastq)
    sample=${sample%.gz}      # strip .gz if needed

    echo "Running NanoPlot on $sample"

    mkdir -p ../analyses/09-nanoplot/"$sample"

    /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/envs/nanoplot_env/bin/NanoPlot \
        --fastq "$fq" \
        -o ../analyses/09-nanoplot/"$sample" \
        --threads 40 \
        --loglength \
        --tsv_stats
done
```
